svg.title: A station bell sends the inspection team hurrying out of the market.
svg.desc: Riju packs his recorded concern while Vale, Cecil and Babul-da turn towards the railway. The station bell rings above the market as the blank forecast remains active behind them.
svg.text: Page 14, panel 6 · Wide market-crossing shot towards the railway direction
